summary: The fix restores the lite-chain qualifier and trims the out-of-scope tests as the verdict directed, but the trim leaves the gate's stored-baseline validation branch with no asserting test.

findings.summary: After a3199ba, no test drives a malformed stored analyze.baseline through gate_violation(state, "implement"), so a regression that accepts a malformed stored baseline at the implement gate would pass every test.
findings.evidence: ENG-1. checks.analyze_baseline (checks.py:236-237) returns the stored baseline only when state.analyze_record_problems(stored) is empty; otherwise falls through. The removed half of test_stored_baseline_is_used_when_valid (a3199ba) was the only gate-level assertion of that fallthrough. Remaining stored-baseline fixtures in test_gates.py are valid. Writer-side validation tested in test_analyze_record.py:203-207; spec.md:109 and tasks.md:9 scope malformed-baseline tests to the state writer.
findings.fix: Obtain fresh protected scope confirmation adding 'malformed stored baseline at the implement gate' as a failure path of gate_violation(state, "implement"), then restore one gate-level assertion; or record the gap as an explicit scope decision against ENG-1.
